constraint.description: Elements annotated with @jQASuppress must provide a suppression reason.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (element:Java:jQASuppress)-[:HAS_SUPPRESSION]->(suppression:jQASuppression) WHERE suppression.reason IS NULL OR suppression.reason = "" RETURN element AS Element

constraint.description: The provided expiration date exceeds the allowed limit (default: 12 months).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (element:Java:jQASuppress)-[:HAS_SUPPRESSION]->(suppression:jQASuppression) WITH element, date(suppression.until) AS until WHERE until > date() + duration({months: $suppressUntilMonthsLimit}) RETURN element AS Element, until AS ExpirationDate

constraint.description: The provided expiration date must not be in the past.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (element:Java:jQASuppress)-[:HAS_SUPPRESSION]->(suppression:jQASuppression) WITH element, date(suppression.until) AS until WHERE until < date() RETURN element AS Element, until AS ExpirationDate

constraint.description: The provided expiration date falls within the timeframe for soon expiring (default: 1 month).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (element:Java:jQASuppress)-[:HAS_SUPPRESSION]->(suppression:jQASuppression) WITH element, date(suppression.until) AS until WHERE until < date() + duration({months: 1}) AND until >= date() RETURN element AS Element, until AS ExpirationDate
